findings.entity: Walking person and black metal railing
findings.description: At 00:00, the walking person's legs are occluded by the vertical bars of the continuous black metal railing, placing them on the planter side behind the barrier. Immediately afterward (between 00:00 and 00:01), the person emerges on the paved walkway side in front of/to the left of the continuous handrail, having passed directly through the solid metal railing where no opening exists.
